product_wide_rationale: Names when a claimed worktree that holds no work may be removed, which every Domain that claims a worktree relies on, so it binds Product-wide rather than owning a runtime Domain.
summary: The worktree audit reports a fifth drift class, unstarted_present: a needed work item whose active, verified worktree has a clean tree and a branch holding no commit beyond the Project's default ref. The audit pass reclaims such rows without operator approval through a commit-count gate in place of the merged-head gate, the work item stays at needed, and the drift row carries commits_ahead as the gate input and claim_age_seconds as a display fact no gate reads. A read whose default ref is underivable skips the class rather than refusing the page. Amends CD-0096 D3 Destroy at the approval sentence and CD-0105 D1 and D2.
title: The worktree audit reclaims unstarted worktrees
